findings.title: README.md: stale '52 open findings' — all 14 findings in index.json are already closed
findings.detail: README.md line 45 stated '52 open findings (6 CRITICAL / 37 IMPORTANT / 9 COSMETIC) as of 2026-05-21.' However, .audits/index.json (last_updated: 2026-05-21T17:49:46Z) shows open_findings: 0 — all 14 findings were closed by the same-day direct-fix audit pass. The README was written before the fixes were applied and was never updated.
findings.fix_sketch: Update the stale count on line 45 to reference index.json for live status instead of hardcoding the count.

findings.title: ifleet-integration-adrs.md: ADR numbering inconsistency — headings use 'ADR-001', prose uses 'ADR-0001'
findings.detail: The document used two numbering conventions: section headings use 'ADR-001', 'ADR-002' while prose references used 'ADR-0001', 'ADR-0002'. Specifically: line 91 referenced 'ADR-0002', and lines 97, 123, 129, 141, 216 referenced 'ADR-0001'. Standardized all to 'ADR-001' / 'ADR-002' to match the heading convention.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed all 'ADR-0001' → 'ADR-001' (5 occurrences) to match the section heading convention.

findings.title: ifleet-integration-adrs.md line 91: 'Docker-unreachable fallback in ADR-0002' is a confusing self-referential parenthetical
findings.detail: ADR-002 Decision section contained '(matches the Docker-unreachable fallback in ADR-0002)'. This was confusing: ADR-002 is the document being described, Docker/containers are not part of this system, and no 'Docker-unreachable fallback' is defined anywhere in ADR-002. Appears to be a residual copy-paste from another codebase. Removed the parenthetical.
findings.fix_sketch: Removed the confusing parenthetical — sentence reads clearly without it.
